summary: Independent end-to-end verification of the Family/Caregiver delegated portal access (v1) feature. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_delegate_access.py (17 tests) and ran a Playwright pass on the Patient (delegate) + Admin (staff) UI flows. 17/17 backend pass; UI flows all working with correct data-testids. All six key invariants empirically verified: (1) delegated audit — delegated Rx audit log carries actor_name='Maria Lopez', actor_role='patient', meta.on_behalf_of_patient_id=Linda, meta.acted_by_user_id=Maria's user_id, meta.delegate_relationship='Daughter' — NEVER attributed solely to the patient. (2) Server-side authZ — unauthorized on_behalf_of (John Smith) returns 404 on read + write; bogus patient_id returns 404; a reduced-permission caregiver (DOCUMENTS only) gets 403 on RX_REQUESTS and 200 on DOCUMENTS. (3) Revoke immediate+soft — created a throwaway caregiver grant, logged in as it, verified access, revoked from admin, verified my-delegations no longer lists Linda, summary returns 404, delegated Rx returns 404, and DB row is active=false with revoked_at set (history preserved). (4) NO duplicate patient identity — POST /internal/caregivers creates a role='caregiver' users row with patient_id=null, must_change_password=true, NO entry in patients collection matching the caregiver email. (5) Documents filter — delegated /portal/documents returns only shared_with_patient attachments; internal-only attachments for Linda are NOT present in the delegate response. (6) Existing patient self-portal UNCHANGED — Maria's /portal/overview and /portal/documents (self, no on_behalf_of) still 200. UI: Maria sees 'People I help manage' card on /portal with Linda listed; /portal/people shows managed-person-card; clicking opens /portal/manage/<Linda_pid>; managed-banner reads 'You are managing Linda Nguyen's account' + Return-to-my-account returns to /portal WITHOUT logout; delegated refill submission shows success toast ('Refill request submitted.'). Admin flow: Patients search 'Linda' -> select -> Family/Caregiver Access section renders with Maria->Linda Active grant + 4 permission chips (Rx requests, Appointments, Request status, Documents) + 'Granted 10/1/2026 - Basis: Patient consent'. Add-access form opens, both 'Existing VIen user' and 'New caregiver' modes work, all 4 permission checkboxes present, relationship + consent selects populated. 409 duplicate guard verified via API. All synthetic artefacts (TEST_DELG tag + emails starting with 'delg_test_') cleaned up in teardown — the real Maria->Linda grant and all demo users were never modified.
critical_code_review_comments: portal_access dependency correctly returns 404 (not 403) for both missing-grant AND cross-practice/wrong-pid cases — no existence leak. Verified empirically.

Audit attribution in PortalCtx.audit_actor()/audit_meta() is correct: delegate's user id+name+role appear as actor_*; patient appears ONLY under meta.on_behalf_of_patient_id. The invariant 'never attributed solely to the patient' holds end-to-end.

create_caregiver reuses an existing users row keyed on email — no duplicate accounts. Correctly returns temp_password ONLY on creation path; reused path returns {reused:true} with no password material.

server.py now 6692 lines (previous iteration 6324). Delegates feature added ~370 lines — Stage C comment about splitting into submodules still stands. Consider moving the four /internal/.../delegates* endpoints + CaregiverCreateBody/DelegateCreateBody into a dedicated router module alongside delegates.py to cap server.py growth.

LOW: /internal/user-search returns str(ObjectId) in `id`, which is then accepted as delegate_user_id in POST /internal/patients/{pid}/delegates. The subsequent ObjectId(delegate_user_id) call could throw bson InvalidId on malformed input — the handler already catches with try/except -> 404 'Delegate user not found.' Good, but consider validating length to return 400 for clearly malformed ids.
LOW: revoke_patient_delegate silently 200s even when the grant is already revoked (no state change). Harmless but could return 409 or {no_op:true} to make audit trails cleaner.

LOW: /portal/managed/{patient_id}/summary passes `ctx.patient['id'] != patient_id` as an extra guard — safe, but given portal_access already resolved ctx.patient from on_behalf_of, this will only fire if a client sends a mismatched path+header pair. Keep as defense-in-depth.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — Maria delegate flow + Admin FamilyAccess panel all render with correct data-testids and perform correctly

seed_data_creation: Only transient synthetic rows: (a) 3 throwaway caregiver users with email prefix 'delg_test_' used for duplicate-reuse / 403-permission / revoke tests, (b) delegated appt + rx tagged _test_tag='TEST_DELG'. Teardown deletes everything matching _test_tag=TEST_DELG across patient_portal_delegates / appointment_requests / prescription_requests, plus any users whose email starts with 'delg_test_'. The real Maria->Linda grant, demo users (maria/linda/john), and the dr-aguayo practice were NEVER modified. One real UI-driven Rx and the DB-visible Oct-2026 refill ('TEST_UI Vitamin D') were submitted during the Playwright pass for Linda — these are legitimate delegated requests and were NOT cleaned up (per the invariant that delegated actions audit as Maria on-behalf-of Linda). If main agent wants them removed, they live in prescription_requests where patient_id=Linda + medication_name startswith 'TEST_'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_delegate_access.py — run with `-o addopts='-p no:xdist'` (same xdist caveat as Stage C). TAG for synthetic data is 'TEST_DELG'. Caregiver seed emails use prefix 'delg_test_'. One UI-created Rx ('TEST_UI Vitamin D' for Linda) was NOT cleaned up — safe to leave but can be deleted via prescription_requests where patient_id='2f4d3a87-1bce-4c30-8212-cf10e64ce3fc' AND medication_name LIKE 'TEST_UI%'. Backend audit shape: flat actor_id/actor_name/actor_role fields + nested meta.{acted_by_user_id, on_behalf_of_patient_id, delegate_relationship}. Appointment POST requires `options:[{date,time,label,display}]` not preferred_date/time; dates must be future (preview is on 2026-10-01). Portal self endpoint /api/portal/overview works for self-login.
